messages:
Jules (Airwave): Hey — we signed up and created project `airwave-prod` but I don't see any API keys in the Console. Trying to call the API returns 401. Can someone check? 🙏

sara: Hi Jules — sorry about that. Can you paste the project id from Settings → Project ID? It looks like the web UI sometimes hides keys for SSO-onboarded orgs.

Jules (Airwave): Project ID is `proj_4273` (I think). Screenshot: [screenshot.png]

mike: @sara fyi we've seen a race where new orgs created by SSO get `legacy_project` flag and keys aren't auto-provisioned.

jordan: Jules — can you run `curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <your-token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/proj_4273/keys` and paste the output? (If you don't have a user token yet that's ok — say so)

Jules (Airwave): I tried `curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys` and get:
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
content-type: application/json
{
  "error": "no_api_keys_provisioned",
  "reason": "project has no service keys"
}
```

sara: OK that matches the bug. @mike can you repro on staging? If confirmed, we can provision a temporary service key for them.

mike: Repro steps I used:
1) Create org via SSO (G Suite) -> Accept invite as first user
2) Create project `test-ssoproj` in console
3) Observe `Settings > API keys` empty and API returns 403

I can repro. Workaround is to run the provisioning script:
```
redwoodctl api-keys create --project proj_4273 --name "airwave-service" --role service
```
That returns a key string.

jordan: Do we want to make this automatic for SSO orgs? Ops may need to run DB migration to set `auto_provision_keys = true` for org record.

sara: For now I'll request a manual key so Jules can continue. Jules — is it ok if we create a service key and paste the value here (or DM)? If you'd rather we can create it and you rotate after verifying.

Jules (Airwave): DM please. Also billing email is billing@airwave.co — we want to rotate after setup.

onboarding-bot: action required: onboarding-infra assigned to create a service key for proj_4273

sara: @onboarding-infra I've opened infra ticket INF-2745 and will attach the key via direct message. ETA ~20m :hourglass:

sre-ops: Note: after provisioning, ensure project policy `allow_user_keys=false` for SSO orgs to avoid accidental user keys exposure.

mike: Filed PR to fix console visibility: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4551 — will add auto-provision toggle.

sara: Done — key DM'd to Jules. Jules can you confirm you can `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <SERVICE_KEY>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models` returns 200?

Jules (Airwave): Confirmed ✅ 200 and model list. Thanks everyone! :tada:

sara: Closing here but leaving INF-2745 open until PR merges. Follow-ups: make auto-provision default for SSO orgs, add UI hint about project owners and keys.

mike: +1

jordan: marking as postmortem candidate for onboarding playbook.

Jules (Airwave): Appreciate the fast help.
